stem: A breeder selects the top 5% of plants from a small family and sees strong performance in the next cycle. What limits the strength of the selection conclusion?
choices: Selection intensity alone proves genetic gain
Small family size and shared environment can exaggerate apparent differences, so replicated progeny evidence is still needed
The best plants should be cloned only
Family size has no effect on confidence
rationale: Selection decisions are stronger when family size, replication and environmental variance are sufficient to distinguish genetic signal from noise.
